Font Awesome Free 6.7.2
https://fontawesome.com

Icons used on this site are inlined as SVG path data rather than loaded from the
Font Awesome webfont or CDN, so no Font Awesome CSS or font file is shipped.

Icons in use (all from the Free set):
  regular/file-lines   -> publication "Abstract" links
  solid/globe          -> publication "Project Page" links
  solid/quote-left     -> publication "BibTeX" links
  regular/envelope     -> contact email link
